title: AIDA distill sidecar
description: What the distiller found when it read one stage's close record fresh, at <task folder>/records/<stage>-distill.json (ideal/agents.md, 'distiller'). It lives under records/ because it is derived and the check runs again; the project's ignore list keeps that folder out of history. Two readers: the `distill` action of the scope, research and design scripts, through distill_read in scripts/lib/task-helpers.sh, and the task skill's `save`. A field present in a real sidecar but absent from `properties` is a defect in the schema, not a value to silently accept, which is why `additionalProperties` is false.

schemaVersion.description: The shape this file was written in, the same field every other record carries. Bumped only when a later change to this schema says so.

stage.description: The stage whose close record was read. It names the record: alignment.json for scope, research/*.json with records/research-check.json for research, design/*.json with design-closed.json for design.

standsAlone.description: Whether a fresh reader, given the record and nothing else, would choose the same way the stage did. False exactly when `gaps` is not empty; distill_read refuses a false beside an empty list.

decisions.description: The decisions the record holds, one sentence each, five at most. The handle a window carries in place of the conversation, never a summary of the whole record.

gaps.description: Each one sentence a person can act on, naming what is missing and where it belongs: an approach with no reason, a rejected alternative left unnamed, a constraint or a library the text assumes, a record path that does not exist. Empty when the record stands alone. A gap is advisory; acting on it is the stage's own action run again.
